profile.headline: Software engineer at Blue Rose Research
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Built a survey-buying API to acquire survey respondents from partner companies. Identified and sold partners on building integrations to help become (probably) the world's largest buyer of consumer surveys.
  * Created a novel ETL platform for ML systems that uses code-and-data based caching to cut compute costs substantially.
  * Designed new survey mechanisms for measuring attention to ads, classifying occupation and education data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Led data engineering for the Education Search vertical team, which creates education-related features on Google Search.
  * Negotiated and managed data partnerships that provided Google with Indian education data.
  * Launched features with millions of DAUs under tight deadlines including math formulas and live CBSE exam results.
  * Created a project-based learning onboarding program for Google Cloud new hires, used by thousands of Googlers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Built realtime ad auction systems and auto-bidders for Yelp advertisers.
  * Migrated Yelp's entire ads codebase from an on-prem segment of a monolithic webapp to a separate service running on AWS.
  * Identified and implemented a number of ad targeting optimizations worth millions of dollars.
